summary: Russian forces conducted strikes on the Odessa port complex, targeting fuel and military equipment depots in Odessa and Chernomorsk. Simultaneously, a massive drone attack targeted the Nizhnekamsk oil refinery cluster in Tatarstan, resulting in casualties. Ukrainian forces launched a large-scale UAV operation, with Russian air defenses reporting the interception of 456 drones across multiple regions.
key_points: Russian forces struck fuel and military equipment depots and a port transshipment complex in the port of Odessa (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32310).
Russian forces struck fuel tanks intended for the Ukrainian Armed Forces in Belyary and Novi Belyary, 28 km from the port of Odessa (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32310).
A massive UAV attack on the Nizhnekamsk oil refinery cluster in Tatarstan resulted in 12 deaths and 39 injuries (Source: @tass_agency/389517).
Russian air defenses reported intercepting 456 Ukrainian UAVs over various Russian regions, including Bryansk, Kursk, and Tatarstan (Source: @tass_agency/389506).
Russian forces attacked a Ukrainian bulk carrier as it exited the Danube (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32316).
Ukrainian strikes have reportedly taken out 43% of Russian refinery capacities since the beginning of the year (Source: @UkraineNow/83333).
Russian forces reported the liberation of the villages of Vasyutinskoye and Toretskoye in the DPR (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32307).
Russian forces attacked the Odessa TPP and seven electrical substations (Source: @tass_agency/389505).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted strikes on the Odessa port complex, targeting fuel and military equipment depots in Odessa and Chernomorsk. Simultaneously, a massive drone attack targeted the Nizhnekamsk oil refinery cluster in Tatarstan, resulting in casualties. Ukrainian forces launched a large-scale UAV operation, with Russian air defenses reporting the interception of 456 drones across multiple regions.

points: Russian forces struck fuel and military equipment depots and a port transshipment complex in the port of Odessa (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32310).
Fuel tanks intended for the Ukrainian Armed Forces were destroyed in Belyary and Novi Belyary, located 28 km from the port of Odessa (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32310).
Russian forces attacked a Ukrainian bulk carrier as it exited the Danube (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32316).
In Odessa, 8 people were injured following a Russian attack that caused a fire in a four-story residential building (Source: @UkraineNow/83335).
In Kharkiv, 12 people were reported injured (Source: @UkraineNow/83335).
The German company Kromberg & Schubert, specializing in electrical cable systems for automotive brands, was destroyed in Zhytomir (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32314).

A massive UAV attack on the Nizhnekamsk oil refinery cluster in Tatarstan, including the TANEKO, TAIFF-NK, and Nizhnekamskneftekhim plants, resulted in 12 deaths and 39 injuries (Source: @tass_agency/389517).

Russian air defenses intercepted 456 Ukrainian UAVs over various regions including Bryansk, Kursk, Kaluga, Tula, Belgorod, Oryol, Voronezh, Rostov, Penza, Ulyanovsk, Saratov, Orenburg, Samara, Moscow, Krasnodar Krai, Tatarstan, and Crimea (Source: @tass_agency/389506).

In the Rostov region, over 70 drones were destroyed in Kamensk-Shakhtinsky, Chertkovsky, Millerovsky, Kamensky, Sholokhovo, Verkhnedonsky, Belokalitvinsky, and Tarasovsky districts (Source: @tass_agency/389506).
Russian air defenses intercepted seven UAVs over Sevastopol (Source: @tass_agency/389486).
In the Voronezh region, a drone strike caused a fire in a utility building and damaged several private houses (Source: @tass_agency/389506).
The Russian Ministry of Defense reported that Russian Armed Forces liberated the villages of Vasyutinskoye and Toretskoye in the DPR (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32307).
A drone was reported in the vicinity of Shtefan-Vodă, Moldova, causing a fire after an explosion (Source: @UkraineNow/83319).
Russian forces attacked a Ukrainian bulk carrier exiting the Danube, contributing to a maritime trade blockade (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32316).
A drone was reported in the Black Sea heading toward the Izmail district of the Odessa region (Source: @kpszsu/72195).
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bomb strikes on the Synelnykove district of the Dnipropetrovsk region (Source: @kpszsu/72198).
Ukrainian strikes using Deep Strike systems have reportedly targeted 697 targets in Russia during the first half of 2026 (Source: @UkraineNow/83333).
Russian forces struck the Odessa TPP and seven electrical substations (Source: @tass_agency/389505).
A ballistic missile threat was reported for Kyiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70024).
A ballistic missile threat was reported for Chernihiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70025).
A ballistic missile threat was reported from Bryansk (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70032).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is characterized by high-intensity strikes against critical infrastructure, specifically targeting energy and logistics hubs. Russian strikes on the Odessa port and electrical substations aim to disrupt Ukrainian maritime trade and power supply. Simultaneously, Ukrainian long-range UAV strikes are successfully targeting Russian refinery clusters, causing significant casualties and economic disruption in Tatarstan.
sections.regional_response: Turkey's Foreign Minister has called for a moratorium on strikes against merchant vessels in the Black Sea due to the impact on Turkish-owned and flagged ships. In Ukraine, President Zelensky has indicated that new contacts regarding diplomacy and air defense will occur soon. In the US, manufacturers like Raytheon and Lockheed are reportedly hesitant to license Patriot interceptor missiles due to intellectual property concerns.
sections.intelligence_notes: The scale of UAV deployment is significant, with Russia reporting 456 interceptions in a single night. The use of 'Deep Strike' capabilities by Ukraine is showing measurable impact on Russian industrial capacity, specifically refineries. The targeting of humanitarian supplies, such as the WHO warehouse in Dnipro, indicates a focus on disrupting logistics and emergency medical support.
